full_judgment: 6. On conclusion of the trial of the suit, the trial Court by its judgment and decree dated 29.09.1989 dismissed the suit. Against the judgment and decree of the trial Court, the plaintiff filed Other Appeal No. 37 of 1999 before the District Judge, Chittagong. The learned Subordinate Judge and First Commercial Court, Chittagong by his judgment and decree dated 18.08.1992 dismissed the appeal, Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the Appellate Court, the plaintiff filed the above-mentioned civil revision before the High Court Division. A learned Judge of the Single Bench by the impugned judgment and order discharged the Rule. Against the impugned judgment and order of the High Court Division, the plaintiff filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.471 of 2004 before this Court and leave was granted to consider the submissions as under :
